Cheers planning crew,
The kennel attendant recorded some notes on cleaning rounds at dusk, and I wanted to pass it on

Dear team,

Please review the carrier checks with care and keep the holding area orderly for every animal under our care. <<FACT F104>> Calm handling remains our best safeguard when a traveler arrives with a worried expression or a pet shows signs of stress, and I appreciate the steady attention everyone has given to these movements. If you notice a crate latch, bedding, or label that needs correction, handle it promptly and record the matter in the usual log so the next handoff stays smooth.

For new bookings and updates, please follow the standard intake steps and keep communication clear with the desk. <<FACT F091>> When a traveler asks about arrangements for a pet such as Ruby, reassure them that the team will stay attentive and that careful preparation helps prevent avoidable delays. If special feeding notes or transit concerns are shared, pass them along in full and avoid leaving anything to memory alone, since accurate detail protects both the traveler and the animal.

If anything unusual occurs during the shift, report it at once and keep the account factual and brief. <<FACT F102>> The whole desk depends on timely reporting, especially when a carrier is moved between services or when a customer needs calm support before departure. Thank you for maintaining a composed standard throughout the evening and for continuing to show patience with each case we handle. Your consistency makes the Companion Animal Travel Desk a reliable point of contact for Aurelia Skyways, and I am grateful for the care you bring to each task.

Kind regards,
Companion Animal Travel Desk
